func (Evidence) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error)

func EvidenceValues() []Evidence
func (Evidence) Known() bool

type ServiceErrorCode string
const ServiceErrorCodeHandlerError
const ServiceErrorCodeInvalidResult

var KnownResources
var ResourceErrorCodes
type Holder struct
  Program string
  Account string
  Amount int64
  Evidence Evidence
  Lease string
  Grant string
  Since string
  Detail string
type ResourceState struct
  Resource string
  Capacity int64
  Held int64
  Holders []Holder
  Observed string
  Instrument string
type HoldersResult struct
  Outcome ResourceCallOutcome
  State *ResourceState
type ResourceList struct
  Resources []string
  Observed string
type ResourcesResult struct
  Outcome ResourceCallOutcome
  List *ResourceList
type Lease struct
  ID string
  Resource string
  Amount int64
  Since string
  RenewBy string
type YieldRecord struct
  Holder string
  Amount int64
  Answer string
  TookMs int64
type AcquireResult struct
  Outcome AcquireOutcome
  Lease *Lease
  Asked []YieldRecord
type YieldRequest struct
  ID string
  Resource string
  Amount int64
  Reason string
  At string
  Lease string
type YieldPage struct
  Requests []YieldRequest
  Next string
type ObserveResult struct
  Outcome ResourceCallOutcome
  Page *YieldPage
type AnswerResult struct
  Recorded bool
type AnswerCallResult struct
  Outcome ResourceCallOutcome
  Answer *AnswerResult
type LeaseChange struct
  Applied bool
  Lease *Lease
type LeaseChangeResult struct
  Outcome ResourceCallOutcome
  Change *LeaseChange
type ProcessBindResult struct
  Outcome ProcessBindOutcome
func Encode(v *ResourceState) []byte
type Refusal struct
  Word string
  Offset int
func (Refusal) Error() string
func Decode(in []byte) (*ResourceState, error)
type FrameWriter interface
  WriteFrame(frame []byte) error
type DispatchError string
func (DispatchError) Error() string
func ServiceName(frame []byte) (string, error)
type FrameExchanger interface
  ExchangeFrame(frame []byte) ([]byte, error)
type ServiceError struct
  Code ServiceErrorCode
  Message string
func (ServiceError) Error() string
const EndpointContract
type DescribedService interface
  DescribeService() (contract string, ready bool, why string)
func DescribeEndpoint(frame []byte, program, version string, services ...DescribedService) ([]byte, error)
type ServedService interface
  DescribedService
  ServiceContract() string
func ServeEndpoint(frame []byte, program, version string, services ...ServedService) ([]byte, error)
type Table interface
  Resources() (ResourcesResult, error)
  Holders(resource string, fresh bool) (HoldersResult, error)
type TableTransport interface
  FrameExchanger
type TableClient struct
func NewTableClient(t TableTransport) *TableClient
type TableDispatcher struct
  Handler Table
func (TableClient) Resources() (result ResourcesResult, err error)
func (TableClient) Holders(resource string, fresh bool) (result HoldersResult, err error)
func (TableDispatcher) DescribeService() (contract string, ready bool, why string)
func (TableDispatcher) DescribeServiceMetadata() (guarantees []string, capabilities map[string]string)
func (TableDispatcher) ServiceContract() string
func (TableDispatcher) WriteFrame(frame []byte) error
func (TableDispatcher) ExchangeFrame(frame []byte) ([]byte, error)
type Leases interface
  Acquire(resource string, amount, waitMs int64) (AcquireResult, error)
  Renew(lease string) (LeaseChangeResult, error)
  Release(lease string) (LeaseChangeResult, error)
  Observe(cursor string, waitMs int64) (ObserveResult, error)
  Answer(request string, answer YieldAnswer, reason string) (AnswerCallResult, error)
  BindProcess(lease string, pid int64) (ProcessBindResult, error)
type LeasesTransport interface
  FrameExchanger
type LeasesClient struct
func NewLeasesClient(t LeasesTransport) *LeasesClient
type LeasesDispatcher struct
  Handler Leases
func (LeasesClient) Acquire(resource string, amount, waitMs int64) (result AcquireResult, err error)
func (LeasesClient) Renew(lease string) (result LeaseChangeResult, err error)
func (LeasesClient) Release(lease string) (result LeaseChangeResult, err error)
func (LeasesClient) Observe(cursor string, waitMs int64) (result ObserveResult, err error)
func (LeasesClient) Answer(request string, answer YieldAnswer, reason string) (result AnswerCallResult, err error)
func (LeasesClient) BindProcess(lease string, pid int64) (result ProcessBindResult, err error)
func (LeasesDispatcher) DescribeService() (contract string, ready bool, why string)
func (LeasesDispatcher) DescribeServiceMetadata() (guarantees []string, capabilities map[string]string)
func (LeasesDispatcher) ServiceContract() string
func (LeasesDispatcher) WriteFrame(frame []byte) error
func (LeasesDispatcher) ExchangeFrame(frame []byte) ([]byte, error)
